728-856-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
728-856-4321-8347.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2585-5330-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-5330-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Grim Monolith, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
751-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3519-5295-7908.easyPrerequisites: The Notary Hobbits' commander tax is 8 or less.
3519-5295-7908.description:
Cast The Notary Hobbits by paying {3}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When The Notary Hobbits enters, it triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of it.
Activate The Notary Hobbits and the two Notary Hobbits tokens by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Halfling you control.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the nontoken Notary Hobbits, adding six {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return The Notary Hobbits from exile to the command zone.
Repeat.
3519-5295-7908.notes: It's possible to start with a higher commander tax, but you'll need to control more Halflings and/or have more mana to start.

3470-5702-6973-7824.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-5702-6973-7824.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

997-1619-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1879-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

338-2060-7610.easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
338-2060-7610.description:
Activate Scholar of Athreos by paying {2}{W}, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
338-2060-7610.notes: The combo will only sustain itself as long as you have three or more opponents.

500-2081-3191-5361.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Auton Soldier and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Auton Soldier dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Auton Soldier tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-2081-3191-5361.notes: The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

3713-5078-6650-6723.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3713-5078-6650-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-4927-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Reckless Fireweaver with "Pirate" chosen

2257-4508-7040.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-4508-7040.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Psychic Paper, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

671-2448-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
671-2448-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Goblin Firestarter enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

864-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
864-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Palinchron
When Eternal Witness and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
864-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

3197-4052-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3197-4052-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2558-3490-5315-6701.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-5315-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

3525-3918-5139.description:
Activate Trazyn using Relic of Sauron's ability by tapping it, adding {U} and either {U}, {B} or {R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
3525-3918-5139.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can instead use Relic of Sauron's second ability.

586-5147-5258-5618-6580.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1018-4067-4851-6281.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

224-1772-2653-3861.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-2034-4766-5222.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender and Sword of the Realms attached to the same nontoken creature you control.
1069-2034-4766-5222.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Sword of the Realms and Deathrender attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature that has Deathrender attached.
Repeat.

282-2921-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2921-5365.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.
282-2921-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

850-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Overgrown Battlement and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
850-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Overgrown Battlement's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1017-1656-2335-3795.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Ally.
1017-1656-2335-3795.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Sea Gate Loremaster's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

575-2034-3739.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nantuko Vigilante, adding {C}{C}.
When Nantuko Vigilante dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nantuko Vigilante from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Nantuko Vigilante by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nantuko Vigilante's morph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Nantuko Vigilante triggers, targeting any artifact and/or enchantment.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Nantuko Vigilante triggers, destroying any number of artifacts and/or enchantments.

2034-2703-2816-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Myr Propagator.
Myr Propagator does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2703-2816-4893.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1938-4875.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Angel was not foretold
1938-4875.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
1938-4875.description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling itself and any number of other creatures you control until it leaves the battlefield.
Glorious Protector and all other exiled creatures return from exile to the battlefield immediately due to Glorious Protector leaving the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to exile Glorious Protector.

662-4096-4407-4853.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
662-4096-4407-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Goblin Welder to become an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Dross Scorpion and returning Unbender Tine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Unbender Tine by tapping it, targeting Goblin Welder.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Unbender Tine and returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Unbender Tine ability, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat from step 2.
